pace.text: Day one. Wednesday. The state archives.
William, son of Monsieur Alphonse Frankenstein, formerly syndic of this Republic. Found dead on the plain of Plainpalais
She fainted. When she came round, she explained. That evening William had begged her to let him wear something precious,
Next time on Darkness and Distance: Justine.

dismissed.expected: she was quiet for a moment
